signal: AI Squared launched a dedicated federal solutions offering, expanding its agentic AI integration platform into government agencies after its $13.8M Series A

email.subject1: a signal play for AI Squared
email.body1:
Nate, saw AI Squared standing up its federal solutions push for government agencies.

Opening a federal motion usually means more in-market agencies and primes than the team can personally work, and that is where pipeline stalls before a rep reaches out. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for AI Squared off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Nate, quick follow-up for AI Squared.

Standing up federal sales, the question is usually how many meetings the team needs to build a real government pipeline. Most teams find out late, and by then the budget cycle is closing.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your federal team needs to hit target this year, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Nate, last bit of proof for AI Squared.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how AI Squared's reply rate likely compares to similar Series-A startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Nate, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling federal pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this year, no problem at all. Standing up a new motion, timing is everything, and I know that build is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a federal motion? I will tailor it to AI Squared either way.
